title: Model Bias in NLP: Application to Hate Speech Classification using transfer learning techniques

bias_targets.target: Classification bias (Conflation of offensive language and hate speech)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generalizability and precision/recall across out-of-domain datasets (Davidson and HASOC 2019) that explicitly separate true hate speech from merely offensive or profane language, measuring the model's ability to avoid false positive censorship.

Qualitative error analysis via manual scanning of the dataset's target labels, demonstrating how human annotators systematically mislabel skeptical, cynical, or populist political comments (e.g., against specific politicians) as hate speech.

primary_bias_target: Classification bias (Conflation of offensive language and hate speech)
